observed_result.runner_survival: runner and its agent, started with setsid nohup inside the controller's SSH session, kept running after that session ended (they stayed in the departed session's scope; KillUserProcesses=false)
observed_result.managed_onward: K_env held only in the runner's agent (key file shredded after load) with a certificate valid_before = issue+150 s: 35/45 ok, from 12 s before to 136 s after the controller left; every attempt from +141 s failed (Permission denied); valid_before was +137 s
observed_result.fixed_onward: runner-local key file: 45/45 ok through +180 s
observed_result.forwarded_agent_control: runner started inside a nested session with a forwarded fixture agent: preflight classified SSH_AUTH_SOCK as forwarded_agent_from_ssh_session(controller_dependency); 3/3 ok while the session lived; every attempt failed from +1 s after the session ended
observed_result.openssh_note: IdentityAgent=none disables agent forwarding even with ForwardAgent=<path> (first fwd attempt never received SSH_AUTH_SOCK)

limitations: MECHANISM PROBE: OpenSSH/logind behaviour with shell stand-ins on one fixture host; not A24/A25/A07 and not a G07 closure record
the bridge and runner are shell stand-ins for `heimdall remote serve` and the runner runtime; they exercise OpenSSH/logind semantics, not Heimdall code
probe sources were uncommitted at run time; devbox run 2026-11-19
the runner restart/reboot rows (K_env loss, re-issue needs the controller) were not run; ADR-0005 §3.7 already fixes them
the sshd log line naming the expiry reason was not retained before the scratch was removed; expiry is inferred from timing (+137 s valid_before, first failure +141 s, no failure before)
linger was already enabled for this account by its owner; a host without linger and with KillUserProcesses=yes was not tested
the controller's issuer is a fixture ssh-keygen CA on the Mac, not Heimdall's issuer
the cleanup was observed in the session (exact-PID kills, scratch removed, no remaining processes) but no standalone cleanup transcript was retained
the host readout describes the fixture host only; it does not establish product secret-store availability
